Director, Operations

Katie Clyde*, non-attorney professional

Katie Clyde is the Director of Operations at The Political Law Group, where she oversees the firm’s administrative, financial and business operations. She brings more than 20 years of experience in procurement, finance and project management and works closely with the firm’s partners and professional staff to develop and maintain the systems and processes that support TPLG’s legal and compliance practices.

katie@tpl.group

Before joining TPLG, Katie worked in both the private and public sectors, including with a Sacramento-based lobbying firm and the State of California. Her background includes government contracting, conflicts-of-interest matters and Statements of Economic Interests (Form 700), giving her a practical understanding of the regulatory environment in which many of TPLG’s clients operate.

*Denotes a non-attorney professional.
